mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recovery_credential (account_id, code_hash, status) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{codeHash}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, code_hash, status, issued_at, consumed_at FROM recovery_credential WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE recovery_credential SET status = 'CONSUMED', consumed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE recovery_credential SET status = 'REVOKED' WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
